mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 78 degrees with mainly clear skies around Verona City Hall, with an air quality index of 55.

The city has two major updates. First, the police department has arrested a 34-year-old teacher on charges of sexual assault of a child. Second, road construction on Highway M enters phase two the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns, while the Military Ridge State Trail will see closures for bridge replacements starting in mid-September.

There is plenty to do today, including the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7 or trivia nights starting September 8.

In a report from the Verona Police Department, authorities confirmed that on Sunday, August 30, they received information regarding an inappropriate relationship between a staff member and a student that occurred in 2019, leading to an arrest on September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
